{{Codex|A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.}}
The '''Karak Wraith''' is the [[Wraith]] variant of the {{Weapon|Karak}} assault rifle, with higher damage, critical stats, [[status chance]], and magazine size.

==Characteristics==

* This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage.

{{Advantages|*Low recoil.|name=Karak Wraith}}

{{Disadvantages|name=Karak Wraith}}

{{WeaponComparison|Karak}}
{{WeaponComparison|Kuva Karak|header=n}}

==Acquisition==
Karak Wraith was introduced during the [[Operation: Tubemen of Regor]] [[event]], where players would need to complete a minimum of four regional battles in favor of one side more than the other, and [[Alad V]] was the victor of the conflict. Alad V had won the conflict in the PC and XB1 versions of the game, but not in the PS4. The weapon was fully built and came with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed [[Orokin Catalyst]].

The blueprint and parts were formerly a reward from the [[Sortie/ArchivedRewards|First and Third]] Seasons of [[Sortie]]s; they can now be found as an [[Invasion]] reward. All components can be [[Trade System|traded]], although players must have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 7 to acquire the blueprint.

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Trivia==
*Curiously, the Karak Wraith's UI icon appears to be missing its magazine and the remainder of the hanging strap.
*The Karak Wraith is the sixth [[Wraith]] weapon to be released.
*When the Karak Wraith has a quarter of its total magazine left, it will sound slightly higher approaching the end of the magazine.
*This weapon is wielded by the [[Lancer#Variants|Nightwatch Lancers]] during the Project Undermine [[Tactical Alert]], perhaps due to the similarity in appearance between Wraith and Nightwatch skins, and the fact that there is no Nightwatch skin for the Karak, {{Weapon|Hind}}, or {{Weapon|Grakata}}.
**This the second time an enemy is seen using an Event Reward weapon (following the [[Stalker]]'s use of the {{Weapon|Braton Vandal}} prior to the introduction of the {{Weapon|Dread}}).

{{Top|Enemy|Grineer|Grineer|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher}} The '''Kulstar''' is a {{Faction|Grineer}}-built torpedo/cluster bomb launcher. Once its torpedo comes in contact with an enemy or a surface, or if the player manually detonates it with [[Alternate Fire]], it detonates and fragments into 3 smaller bomblets, which spread from the point of impact, also exploding on impact. This weapon can be sold for {{cc|5,000}}. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals innate {{D|Blast}} damage. *Rocket explodes in a '''3''' meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy, then splits into '''3''' smaller cluster bombs that rain down on the point of impact. **Explosions and cluster bombs have innate {{D|Blast}} damage — effective against [[Damage/Infested Deimos|Infested Deimos]]. **[[Alternate Fire]] prematurely detonates the rocket and cluster bombs mid-flight. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Can benefit from {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}). *Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity. {{Advantages| *Very high [[accuracy]]. }} {{Disadvantages| *Very high recoil when not aiming. *Rockets have travel time. *Poor ammo economy. **Extremely small magazine size of just 3 rounds; requires frequent reloading. **Extremely low ammo capacity of just 15 rounds; requires just 5 reloads to fully deplete all ammo reserves. *Explosions and cluster bombs inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Explosions and cluster bombs have a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. *Explosions and cluster bombs have linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 60% from central impact. }} ==Acquisition== The Kulstar's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *Cluster bombs are launched in a loose arc away from the primary explosion in a similar fashion to spawning pods from [[Boiler]]s. **This may make it difficult to hit a single enemy with the primary explosion and cluster bombs and makes it so that arcing bomblets constitute an extra self-stagger hazard. *[[Multishot]] mods will only affect the rocket; the number of bomblets generated per rocket will always be 3. **Additional projectiles generated by Multishot will assume a geometric formation, as per the {{Weapon|Angstrum}}; 2 rockets will fire in a horizontal line, 3 rockets will fire in a triangle, 4 rockets will fire in a diamond, and 5 rockets will fire in a pentagon. *The Kulstar possesses an unusual difference in recoil between hipfire and aiming. When hipfiring, the Kulstar has very high recoil per shot, violently shaking aim, while stopping to aim will drastically reduce the recoil. ==Tips== *{{A|Magnetize}} will focus both the main projectile and its bomblets to a single target, delivering heavy damage to it. *{{A|Hall of Mirrors}} can be used with the Kulstar to devastating effect, saturating an area with explosions and wiping out entire squads. This combination can be further improved if {{M|Hall of Malevolence}} is used. ==Trivia== *The Kulstar was first presented in the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?t=32&v=oAVA_vGb9_w Echoes of the Sentients Highlight Video]. *The Kulstar could be an intentional mispronunciation of the word "Cluster", which would be fitting given the Kulstar's projectiles are [[wikipedia:Cluster munition|cluster bombs]]. **The bomblets themselves resemble [[wikipedia:Naval_mine#Contact_mines|naval contact mines]]. While smaller than the torpedoes, they are much higher resolution as they are recoloured versions of the mines from the [[Grineer Sealab]] tileset. ==Media== KlustarCodex.png|Kulstar in Codex. Kulstar Torpedo.jpg|A Kulstar torpedo (rocket) with the default colours. Kulstar mine.jpg|A Kulstar bomblet with the default colours. {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|ZpQBDTR-v6w|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|P383l2mrbTo|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|KxYHrZCDE0E|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|zHQBnm93pgI|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|yKkr1jQGcWQ|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|P7scQmxM074|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|nl4aNfjpW9A|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|BoT1gPJVbI4|size=300px}} }} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 3 Ammo per Pick Up: *Kulstar ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. {{ver|27.2.2}}
Reduced the following AoE weapons Radial Damage Falloff from central impact that were all previously 90%: *Kulstar: 40% {{ver|27.2}} ;Self Damage Changes: We are getting rid of Self Damage and replacing it with something else: instead of Self Damage, it’s now ‘Stagger’. This change completely removes the chance of killing yourself, and instead now creates scenarios where you will interrupt yourself - or ‘Stagger’ - to varying degrees if you aren’t careful. The degrees of Self-Interrupt start with a small stumble all the way to full knockdown depending on how close you are to the center of explosion. Any Mods referring to Self Damage will be converted to acknowledge Stagger. With this Self-Interrupt system, we have added dozens of new recovery animations that harness a ninja-like recovery experience. By pressing ‘Jump’ at the correct time, you can execute a ninja-skill-based knockdown recovery to ALL in-game knockdowns. This ninja recovery window is indicated by a glowing FX on your Warframe. In the original Dev Workshop, we said:
''As a result of this overall systemic change, Weapons with Stagger will be getting approximately a 20% buff in Damage, with any weapons with AOE receiving a 50% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact.'' This is no longer accurate after continued testing. What we are doing now is: No damage buffs have been added, but any weapons with AOE are receiving ~20% increase in Radius. Additionally, AOE weapons are receiving a 90% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact. This means on the very outer section of the explosion Radius 10% of the Damage will be dealt. Tactics will be deadly - aim true, Tenno. ''Why: Several players brought up the history of the Tonkor and we want to make sure we ship this change in a place that’s conservative in its starting point from a balance perspective. The complete removal of Self Damage does change the pace of destruction with some of the game’s most powerful weapons, so we want to make sure we can iterate upwardly instead of releasing a bonanza of explosions with no other choices.'' {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 4 to 5. *Changed contact damage from Explosion to Impact. *Added guaranteed Knockdown to contact damage. *Contact damage increased from 175 to 200. *Radial damage increased from 200 to 300. *Status chance increased from 10% to 19%. *Critical chance increased from 5% to 17%. *Critical damage increased from 2x to 2.3x. *Improved projectile trail FX of the bomblets after the initial explosion. *Ammo capacity decreased from 30 to 15. *Added recoil. *Decreased accuracy. {{ver|20.0}} *Arsenal now includes alt-fire stats for the Kulstar. {{ver|The Index Preview}} *Increased damage of Kulstar in Conclave. *Kulstar projectiles are now more visible in Conclave. {{ver|18.5}} *Increased AoE damage of the Kulstar in Conclave. *Increased the damage of the Kulstar in Conclave. {{ver|18.4.10}} *Removed the headshot multiplier from the Kulstar in Conclave. *The Kulstar's explosive damage no longer ignores cover in Conclave. {{ver|17.2.2}} *Reduced the number of visual particle FX on the Kulstar's explosions. {{ver|17.0.5}} *Reduced the damage of the Kulstar in PvP. {{ver|17.0.3}} *Fixed the Kulstar's secondary fire hitting enemies outside of Limbo's rift while Limbo is riftwalking. {{ver|17}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|23.2.1}} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Angstrum}}, a similar secondary rocket launcher. *{{Weapon|Kuva Bramma}}, a Grineer bow that fires a similar projectile. {{WeaponNav}} [[Category:Splitting Projectiles]] [[Category:Grineer]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Secondary Weapons]] [[Category:Launcher]] [[Category:Launcher (Secondary)]] [[Category:Single Sidearm]] [[Category:Update 17]] [[es:Kulstar]] [[uk:Кулстар]] [[Category:Blast Damage Weapons]]

{{Top|Enemy|Sentient|Sentient|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add [[punch through|punch through]]. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.}} The '''Komorex''' is an [[Amalgam]] [[Sniper Rifle|sniper rifle]] produced by the {{Faction|Corpus}} that incorporates {{Faction|Sentient}} technology in its design. Featuring a large magazine, high [[status chance]], fast [[fire rate]], two unique [[zoom]] modes for reduced [[recoil]] on the lowest zoom or boosted {{D|Viral}} damage explosion at max zoom, and innate 100% [[Ammo#Increasing_Ammo_From_Pickups|Ammo Mutation]], but suffers from having the lowest base damage and second lowest [[critical chance]] of any sniper rifle. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage. *Innate 100% [[Ammo#Increasing_Ammo_From_Pickups|Ammo Mutation]] effect. *Two zoom modes: **First zoom has '''2.0x''' zoom distance, '''-50%''' [[recoil]], and '''2''' meter [[punch through]]. **Second zoom has '''3.5x''' zoom distance, '''+100%''' {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Puncture}}, {{D|Slash}}, adds a '''3.5''' meter explosion dealing '''106''' {{D|Viral}} damage, and '''-75%''' fire rate. ***Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. ***Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. ***Fire rate debuff can be disabled using {{M|Semi-Rifle Cannonade}}. ***Can benefit from {{M|Cautious Shot}}. {{Advantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Pinpoint [[accuracy]] while [[zoom]]ed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for [[Enemy Body Parts|headshots]]. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Tied with {{Weapon|Vectis Prime}} for the largest shot combo requirement of all sniper rifles. **Second zoom explosion does not affect combo counter. *Lowest zoom distance of all sniper rifles. *Extremely inaccurate when fired from the hip. *Projectiles have travel time. *Second zoom explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Second zoom explosion cannot [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]]. *Second zoom explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 60% from central impact. *Second zoom explosion cannot benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) despite being area of effect. }} ==Acquisition== The Komorex's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Energy Lab|Energy Lab]] in the [[dojo]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *The '''-75%''' fire rate from the 3.5x zoom bonus is additive with mods, making it significantly offset by mods such as {{M|Vile Acceleration}}, but also severely punished with only {{M|Critical Delay}} equipped. *The '''+100%''' damage from the 3.5x zoom bonus is '''not''' +100% to base damage, but more specifically grants the following: **'''+100%''' {{D|Impact}} **'''+100%''' {{D|Puncture}} **'''+100%''' {{D|Slash}} *The scope bonus is therefore additive with physical and elemental mods such as {{M|Fanged Fusillade}}. *[[Punch through]] causes the 3.5x zoom explosion to only occur on the '''last''' target or surface it cannot penetrate. This breaks the norm where explosions usually explode on their first hit surface, and even disable punch-through entirely for the projectile. *Modded ammo mutation has no additional effect due to Komorex's 100% innate ammo mutation. It also cannot equip {{M|Sniper Ammo Mutation}} or {{M|Primed Sniper Ammo Mutation}}. {| class="wikitable" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:center;border:1px solid black;width:80%;font-size:12px;" |- ! scope="col" |Combo Counter Bonus Tier ! scope="col" |Total Base Damage Multiplier ! scope="col" |Minimum Consecutive Hits Required |- |1 || 1.5x || 5 |- |2 || 2.0x || 15 |- |3 || 2.5x || 45 |- |4 || 3.0x || 135 |- |5 || 3.5x || 405 |- |6 || 4.0x || 1215 |- |7 || 4.5x || 3645 |- |8 || 5.0x || 10935 |} ==Tips== *The innate {{D|Viral}} damage added on the max zoom option can allow it to more quickly deal with higher level [[Grineer]] and [[Corpus]] enemies, by modding the weapon with {{D|Corrosive}} or {{D|Toxin}} damage respectively. This will allow the viral damage to scale faster against [[armor|armored]] enemies, and decimate Corpus through [[shield|shields]]. *The Komorex can fire 3.5x shots slightly faster if the user unscopes and rescopes between each shot, letting firing cycle finish using the base fire rate value. Note that Komorex's fire rate is '''hard-capped''' around a value of {{text||8.0|hover=Fire rate caps are not well documented or understood. This value was measured at 60 FPS using a free-spinning scrollwheel at hundreds of inputs per second.}}, slightly below the typical semi-auto fire rate limit of 10. *Players may opt to install {{M|Semi-Rifle Cannonade}} as the mod's negation of any changes to the weapon's [[Fire Rate]] also applies to the reduction when adjusting to the 3.5x zoom level. Knowing this, players may also opt to install {{M|Critical Delay}}. **As the explosion at the 3.5x zoom level only applies to the last target penetrated via [[Punch Through]], keeping {{M|Semi-Rifle Cannonade}} unranked may be considered to maximize explosion damage, as the fire rate lock is the same at all mod ranks. ==Trivia== *The Komorex's name may be a portmanteau of the words ''[https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/komo#Hawaiian Komo]'' (Hawaiian word for "enter", "go into", and "penetrate") and ''[https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rex#Latin Rex]'' (Latin word for "king"). *Alternatively, "Komorex" could be a portmanteau of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Komodo_dragon Komodo dragon] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tyrannosaurus tyrannosaurus rex]. This is because a side view of the weapon has a faint resemblance to the profile of a reptilian head with jaws agape. *The Komorex and {{Weapon|Cyanex}} are the only two [[Research/Energy Lab|Energy Lab Research]] weapons with a 12 hour build time. *Komorex has a unique reload animation where the Warframe grips the barrel and holds the gun vertically while folding the rod to eject the magazine, then holds the weapon at its base and adds a new clip which causes the gun to twirl twice. *Komorex used to have a Damage Multiplier that counted towards all status damage, including {{D|Slash|Bleed}} and {{D|Gas|Gas Cloud}}, as a multiplier unique from sources such as {{WF|Ash}}'s passive and faction damage such as {{A|Roar}}. Testing during [[Update 39]] indicates that the multiplier no longer exists. ==Media== File:The-Jovian-Concord-Komorex.jpg|Excalibur with Komorex File:Nikita-leshakov-komorex-lowpoly.jpg File:Nikita-leshakov-komorex-highpoly.jpg Komorex 3.png Komorex 2.png Komorex 1.png|Komorex as shown in the Arsenal {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|JdA-WkY2Bj0|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|1gGglp63PJI|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|uuSoGrvlpbM|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.2}} ;SEMI-AUTOMATIC WEAPON CHANGES While reviewing the stats of some weapons with a semi-automatic mode, we noticed that certain weapons had an unsustainably high fire rate for most players. We adjusted the stats of the following semi-automatic weapons whose maximum potential was only being reached with the use of macros (to learn more about third-party use in Warframe visit our [https://digitalextremes.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360030014351-Third-Party-Software-and-You support article]). Since not everyone is an avid macro user (within the boundaries allowed), '''we lowered fire rates to a more humanly achievable level and improved their damage or reload stats to compensate.''' '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Komorex ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. They now use the same rules as hitscan rifles which give you a combo stack for every bullet in your shot regardless of whether that bullet causes damage or not. {{ver|29.5}} *Fixed Xaku’s Xata’s Whisper sometimes not applying its damage buff or Void Status Effect when using the Komorex. {{ver|27.2.2}}

{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.}} The {{Weapon|Kompressa}} is {{WF|Yareli}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] bubble-gun pistol sidearm that volleys a torrent of sticky and explosive {{D|Viral}} bubbles. In Yareli's hands, the weapon gains increased [[Projectile Speed]]. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Viral}} damage. *Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity. *Bubbles explode in a '''2.4''' meter radius after '''0.6''' - '''0.8''' seconds on impacting a surface or enemy. **Explosion delay reduces likelihood of inflicting {{D|Stagger|self-stagger}}, but may allow enemies to move out of the explosion range if not directly hit by the bubble. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Can benefit from {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}). {{Advantages| *Innate [[multishot]] of 4 bubbles. }} {{Disadvantages| *Extremely inaccurate at long distances. *Projectiles have travel time. *Limited range of 25.6 to 41.6 meters. *Explosion inflicts {{D|Stagger|self-stagger}}. *Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. *Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 80% from central impact. }} {{WeaponComparison|Kompressa Prime}} ==Acquisition== [[Roky]] sells the main blueprint and component blueprints to Tenno at '''Rank 5 - Logical''' with {{Faction|Ventkids}}. She will sell the blueprints for {{sc|25,000}} each, for a total of {{sc|75,000}} for all parts. A component is also offered as a rank-up reward upon reaching '''Rank 5 - Logical'''. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *When wielded by {{WF|Yareli}} ({{WF|Yareli Prime|Prime}}), {{Weapon|Kompressa}} ({{Weapon|Kompressa Prime|Prime}}) gains '''+30%''' [[Projectile Speed]]. *Although Kompressa's bubble projectiles are extremely inaccurate at long ranges, the resulting delayed AoE explosions can still deal good damage. Equipping {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}) can help compensate for the inaccuracy at such ranges by expanding the AoE range. *Has a hidden synergy with {{M|Surging Blades}}, allowing the blades to be captured by bubbles when blades are thrown into bubble clusters allowing them to grow in size and shred enemies who get near them. *Due to a bug versus a significant number of large enemies, (such as the [[Profit-Taker Orb]] and [[H-09 Efervon Tank]]) the bubbles from the Kompressa will deal the initial damage on impact, but not attach an exploding bubble. This leads to a massive decrease in damage, effectively making the weapon useless against these enemies. ==Tips== *Kompressa's delayed burst damage can prove advantageous against crowds of enemies that are protected by a [[Nullifier Crewman]] or, in [[Arbitrations]], [[Arbitration Shield Drone]]s, as the initial shot impact can destroy these protective barriers while the resulting exploding blobs can proceed to clear out the once protected enemies. *The Kompressa is functionally silent despite having an "Alarming" noise level; the bubbles and explosions can be fired near enemies without alerting them. However, they will still break {{WF|Ivara}}'s {{A|Prowl}} unless the {{M|Suppress}} mod is equipped. *{{Arcane|Cascadia Empowered}} is a viable enhancement for Kompressa, due to its capacity for landing a lot of status effects on enemies. *{{Arcane|Secondary Encumber}} is a great option for priming. ==Media== KompressaFinal.png|Finished model {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|q8xMOUVRFko|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Bugs== *The UI for the weapon will not reflect explosion range increases beyond the default, but this is only visual. ==Trivia== *Kompressa is derived from the Japanese pronunciation of '[[wiktionary:compressor|Compressor]]' ''コンプレッサー'' , as the pistol fires pressurized water globs that explosively burst from sudden decompression. ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|38.6.2}} *Fixed a typo in Kompressa Receiver. {{ver|37}} *Fixed Kompressa’s projectiles flying outside of Mag’s Magnetize instead of being pulled in like other projectiles. {{ver|32.2}} *Fixed the Kompressa’s explosions causing significant spikes in GPU/CPU times. *Fixed Kompressa’s bubbles exploding abrupting right after firing due to increased multishot from Mods. As reported here: https://www.reddit.com/r/Warframe/comments/ykavlx/kompressa_bugged_currently_bubbles_partially/ {{ver|32.1}} *Fixed Kompressa’s additional bubbles (after the first 4) not exploding with radial damage as intended when modded with Multishot. {{ver|32.0.7}} *Fixed an issue with Kompressa’s audio FX where high multishot mods caused the explosions to cut audio up when hitting max instances. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 20 Ammo per Pick Up: *Kompressa ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. {{ver|30.5.4}} *Fixed the Kompressa’s disarmed model being the Stug. {{ver|30.5.3}} *Fixed Chat Links for the Kompressa lacking build/acquisition hints. {{ver|30.5.2}} *Fixed missing acquisition information for the Kompressa. {{ver|30.5}} *Introduced. }} {{WeaponNav}} [[Category:Update 30]] [[Category:Yareli]] [[Category:Signature Weapons]] [[uk:Компресса]]
